definitions.explanation: A person who provides aid, assistance, or support to others. Used in contexts ranging from international humanitarian aid to personal help and social welfare.

examples.japanese: {援助者|えんじょしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The aid workers arrived at the site.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{難民|なんみん}→難民：05313_nanmin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{援助者|えんじょしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧してきた。
examples.english: She has been working as an aid worker for refugees for many years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{援助者|えんじょしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{駆|か}けつけ→駆けつける：14632_kaketsukeru⟧、⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧や⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: Many aid workers rushed to the disaster-affected area and took charge of distributing food and supplies.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{援助|えんじょ}→援助：01892_enjo⟧ (aid; assistance) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Follows the common pattern of noun + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ to indicate the person who performs or embodies the action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {援助者|えんじょしゃ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to work as an aid provider
- {援助者|えんじょしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{派遣|はけん}→派遣：13273_haken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to dispatch aid workers
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{援助者|えんじょしゃ}: international aid worker

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援者|しえんしゃ}→支援者：24919_shiensha⟧: supporter — slightly broader; often used for political or organizational backing
- ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧: volunteer — unpaid helper, not necessarily in the context of formal aid
- {救援者|きゅうえんしゃ}: rescuer; relief worker — emphasizes emergency rescue
- ⟦{後援者|こうえんしゃ}→後援者：21846_kouensha⟧: patron; sponsor — financial or organizational backer
